text:
sara.k: Heads-up — we need a short PRD snippet and acceptance checklist for the compliance launch gating around per-customer key boundaries + audit evidence packaging. Came up in sales call — multiple customers expect different retention windows and some require HSM-backed keys.
andreww: +1. can we scope minimal MVP vs enterprise?
ella: sounds right. MVP should be: default KMS with tenant key isolation (logical), configurable audit-log retention, and clear exportable evidence. Enterprise add-ons: customer-managed HSM, longer retention tiers, and signed evidence bundles.
mike_r: quick note: signed evidence requires deterministic log formatting + immutable sequence numbers. otherwise auditors will flag gaps.
sara.k: good call. i'll draft acceptance criteria. thoughts on tradeoffs between per-customer HSM vs dedicated deployment?
andreww: tradeoff: HSM (bring-your-own or ours) increases ops complexity + cost. Dedicated Private deployment simplifies isolation but is heavier to onboard. For 80% customers we can offer KMS keys (our KMS multi-tenant but separated keys), and advertise HSM as enterprise opt-in.
ella: also need SLOs: when using customer-managed HSM we need clear failover plan. who owns key rotation during outages? add to PRD.
ops-sre: we must consider log continuity during key rotation. if encryption keys rotate, ensure that audit-log integrity can still be verified (signatures link across rotations).
mike_r: edge case: cross-region replication + retention policies — customer in EU wants 10y retention, but infra in US — jurisdiction/regulatory implications. PRD should list data residency constraints + mapping to retention config.
sara.k: drafting snippet: "MVP: per-tenant logical key separation; default 1y audit retention; exportable evidence in signed zip; admin UI to request extended retention. Enterprise: HSM integration, per-tenant retention up to 10y, evidence notarization, SOC2 readiness artifacts." ok?
andreww: add acceptance criteria bullets in thread please.
sara.k: acceptance criteria (draft):
- Customer can opt into extended retention via console or support ticket (owner: product)
- For default tenants, audit logs retained for 365 days and available for export in standard format (CSV + jsonl)
- Evidence export contains verifiable signatures and a manifest with sequence hashes
- HSM-integration: customer can supply key material (BYOK) or request Redwood-managed HSM; key usage logs surfaced to customer
- Support access to keys/logs is auditable and requires justification + timebound devops role grants
- Rollout plan: canary on Dedicated customers, feature-flag for Hosted, private deploy checklist for on-prem
- Compliance artifacts: SOC2/ISO mappings documented in repo and product evidence pack generated on demand
ella: Edge cases to enumerate for RFC:
- Key rotation windows overlapping export requests
- Emergency key revocation & how it affects evidence verification
- Partial writes during retention policy change (e.g., downgraded retention)
- Multi-region reads when retention mismatch exists
- Customer requests for log redaction (legal takedown)
mike_r: concrete example for the evidence manifest (for devs):
```
{
  "tenant_id": "t-123",
  "exported_at": "2026-03-18T15:00:00Z",
  "log_ranges": [["1680000000","1682592000"]],
  "signature_scheme": "ed25519",
  "signer": "kms://projects/redwood/hsm/tenant/t-123",
  "sequence_root_hash": "sha256:..."
}
```
sara.k: nice. i'll paste that into the PRD doc. who wants to own the HSM integration RFC?
andreww: i'll pick RFC lead but will need ops-sre and mike_r review.
ops-sre: we'll validate operational runbook (rotation, emergency procedures).
ella: product will scope UI work and acceptance tests. estimate: MVP 3 sprints, enterprise HSM 4-6 sprints after MVP sign-off.
mike_r: tests to add: tamper simulation, rotation cross-check, region failover export.
triage-bot: Reminder: create RFC issue and link PRD draft — due in 3 business days.
sara.k: action items: (1) andreww to open RFC issue + draft design (due EOD Thu), (2) sara.k to create PRD stub and acceptance checklist in product repo (due Mon), (3) ops-sre to draft runbook skeleton (due Mon), (4) mike_r to add verification tests list. I'll tag customers who requested extended retention.
andreww: noted. ping me in #eng-ml if we need infra quotas for canary.
sara.k: thanks. added everyone to the doc. we'll sync in PRD review meeting next Tue. :calendar:
